prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail rose pink hair — her bare skin covered from the neck down with luminous molecular-structure imagery: glowing ball-and-stick molecules in cyan, magenta and gold linked by fine bright bonds across her torso, hexagonal carbon rings winding along her arms and legs, tiny element labels and soft depth-of-field glow on a deep blue shimmer, the glow sitting in living skin and following every curve beneath it, covering all of her skin from the neck to the ankles and the backs of her hands, her face left unpainted and the pattern fading out at the neck. Her face, ears, neck and hands are real living skin with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs, a soft natural flush. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of polished deep-indigo leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each longer than her middle finger, in glossy deep-indigo polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.

Background: a sunny plaza at the foot of glass skyscrapers with pale paving, a low fountain edge, standard-height glass doors and benches, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows on the skin, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
